business.en: These are companies whose main business has nothing to do with electricity.
business.zh: 这些公司的主营业务与电力毫无关系。

business.en: Was it: a) he lost his job as an artist, b) his first business ran out of money, or c) his first full length film was a failure?
business.zh: 选项是：a) 他失去了画师的工作，b) 他的第一家公司资金耗尽，还是 c) 他的第一部长篇电影失败了？

budget.en: Nuclear power has a long history of projects that were promised on time and on budget, and then arrived years late and billions over.
budget.zh: 在核电领域，承诺按时完工、不超预算，最终却拖延数年并超支数十亿美元的项目屡见不鲜。
